annotations.title: Let a mission continue past its credit limit

description: A mission that reached its credit limit pauses until a member lets it continue. This raises the mission's limit by one step and runs the stage that stopped again, so it spends credits: ask the person first. Returns the new limit. Answers 409 when the mission is not at its limit. Requires the missions:run scope.

issueId.description: The mission's issue id: a Linear key or a GitHub Issues id, e.g. SHIP-412

projectId.description: Project id the mission belongs to (get_mission's summary.projectId)
